blurb: This check verifies that device files (block and character) on local jfs/jfs2 filesystems, and the directories that hold them, are not world-writable except for device nodes the vendor intends any user to open, such as /dev/null. A world-writable device node or a world-writable directory containing device nodes lets any local user replace or remove the node and thereby disrupt or divert the device it represents.
